# Berutek

> Boutique software consulting studio run by Giovanny Bernal, a full-stack
> developer and systems engineer with 3+ years building production software
> for startups and small teams.

## Who

Giovanny Bernal — Full-Stack Developer & Systems Engineer, founder of Berutek.
Every project is handled personally by Giovanny, end-to-end: no rotating
team, no handoff gaps.

## What we do

- Full-stack web development (Next.js, React, Node.js)
- Backend API development (Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot)
- Cloud infrastructure & DevOps (Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Docker)
- Linux systems administration (server hardening, SSH/SFTP)
- Database design & management (MySQL, MongoDB)
- Automation & integrations (Python, Google APIs, OAuth)
- Custom email server setup (SMTP/IMAP, SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
- CRM & workflow integrations

## Who it's for

Startups and small teams who need production-grade software without the
overhead, slow timelines, or communication gaps of a large agency.
